summary: Application shell components, Context Providers, and React Flow views used within the Next.js App Router.
context_hints: ProjectEditor.tsx composes the workspace shell; feature business logic belongs under src/features
Contains the 'Nodes' implementation for React Flow

subdirectories.nodes: Custom React Flow node components (e.g., VideoNode, TextNode). The visual representation of data.
subdirectories.copilot: Components for the Chatbot/AI Assistant sidebar interface.

key_files.ProjectEditor.tsx: The primary workspace component integrating React Flow and the Toolbar.
key_files.copilot/AgentAnnotationBlock.tsx: Special composer block for editable agent-addressable review notes from Canvas, Timeline, and Director Stage.
key_files.copilot/AgentAnnotationContextMenu.tsx: Shared context-menu action that sends an addressable workspace object into the composer.
Captures native text selections inside creative surfaces, renders numbered anchored highlights, and queues an optional comment through the shared agent annotation contract.
key_files.LoroSyncContext.tsx: React Context provider for the Loro CRDT sync engine.
key_files.VideoEditorContext.tsx: State management for the video editing timeline.

architecture_notes: Keep ProjectEditor focused on workspace composition. Asset Preview/Edit, thumbnails, media resolution, and action clients belong in src/features/assets; shared action semantics belong in @clash/shared-types/actions.
